narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms developed across east-central and southeastern Oklahoma during the early morning hours of the 8th. The strongest storms produced large hail up to quarter size. Thunderstorms moving repeatedly over the same areas also resulted in localized flash flooding.
ev: Portions of Highway 113 west of Canadian, and several streets in town were flooded.
lsr: Water covering Highway 113 west out of Canadian. City streets in Canadian also covered. Relayed via social media.
